Brittney Lee Hamilton is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Hamilton was born on January 29, 1985. As an adult, she became a voice actress and also guest-starred in a few American TV shows. Hamilton joined in the beginning of . Her most prominent roles are 's rival Georgia in Pokémon the Series: Black & White, and new island kahuna Hapu in .
